Both are decision engines, and both run better on governed telemetry, evaluation-driven ML and cost telemetry.

items: View definitions, session metrics and retention measures inconsistent; product decisions wobble.
Cost per stream/hour by CDN/region/codec unknown; margin leaks.
Password sharing and stream-ripping drain ARPU; enforcement blunt.
Recommendations plateau without governance over objectives (engagement vs. satisfaction).

blocks.x: In Streaming & Digital Platforms, the pattern is objective-governed recommendations, multi-objective recommendation with evaluation gates. Satisfaction-weighted engagement sits on top as the measured result, tracked from the signed baseline onward. Around it, the work is model and retrieval engineering with evaluation wired in from the first sprint, grounded answers, cited sources, and a cost line somebody actually owns.
